A.    Answer the following questions.
                           1.   What was Gopi doing on the veranda?
                           2.   What sound did Gopi hear before he went to
                                the garden?
                           3.   Describe Gopi’s search for the ball.
                           4.   Complete the table given below.

                                S.                                   The dialogue The dialogue
                                           Dialogue
                                No.                                  was said by   was said to
                                 a.   The ball I found
                                      is a hockey ball.

                                 b. My father bought
                                    me a brand-new
                                    football.

                                 c.   I lost a ball four
                                      months ago.

                                 d. Show me the ball
                                    and I will tell you.

                           5.   Who grabbed the ball from Gopi? How did
                                the game start?
                           6.   Why did everyone laugh at the end of
                                the story?

                                                                           Gone with the Scooter   15

B.   Think and answer
                              1.   What would you have done if, like Gopi, you
                                   had found a ball that did not belong to you?
                              2.   Imagine what happens to the hockey ball
                                   after it is taken away by the scooter. Where
                                   does it go? Who finds it?
                              3.   Notice that the scooterist is wearing a
                                   helmet. Why is it important to wear a
                                   helmet? Should the pillion rider also wear
                                   a helmet?


                           Note       Initiate a discussion on various aspects of road safety.
                           to the
                           Teacher
